reviews.text: Good and competent staff.

About a week ago, I went to PetXL to buy food for my dog, who had just turned one year old. I wanted to buy the same puppy food he had been on, while also buying adult food to gradually accustom him to the new food.

Unfortunately, the employee who helped me seemed unfriendly and passive-aggressive. I explained that my dog ​​is the size of a Chihuahua and is used to small kibble, but the adult food I was recommended had marble-sized kibble. So I had to go back to the store to change it.

When I returned, I was fortunately helped by a very nice employee who helped me find the right food. Unfortunately, the same employee who was rude last time rudely interrupted our conversation while I was standing at the checkout.

All in all, a bad experience, but the nice employee I met today made me increase my rating from 1 to 2 stars.
Very nice pet shop with nice and helpful staff. Good service and nice atmosphere. Recommended!

I got lousy crockery the last time I was at petxl at Alna. It was so lousy that I asked them to remove me as a member. Which they said they would do. They still send me advertising. I contacted the store and they couldn't do anything, you can't call customer service. They wouldn't do anything about the lousy crockery I got. MUSTI IS THE STORE THAT COUNTS.

Just bought a hamster cage at PetXL Alna. When we came out of the store we discovered that the cage was already cracked on the side. I went back in with the cage, as I obviously don't go home with a broken cage that is brand new. Was refused a return, as they said it was our fault and not the store's. I am incredibly disappointed with the customer service here, and I don't think this was handled well at all. I will go to Buddy next time.
Lousy customer service

We always have a wonderful experience with you.

I would like to specifically highlight two of your employees: Madelen Strande and Bjørn Kristian. My roommate and I drive from Sandvika in Bærum, and past 3 other pet stores with live fish to shop with you. Solely because of the customer service your employees provide us.

Here you will find everything you need for your animals. Toys, food, cages. HUGE selection. Biggest pet store I have ever been to. A whole wall of aquarium fish and ladders so that toddlers can climb up and see the fish in the aquariums further up. Guppies are so cute in all colors and with glowing tails. Fighting fish are surprisingly small...pink, black and white striped, glowing blue, green. The selection is so big. Plants and decor. On a day with bad weather it is exciting to take children to look. Large section for guinea pigs, but only animals in 1 of 10 cages. Large bird cage too.

I was actually going to buy some supplies for my cat, but after an unpleasant incident I decided not to.
A girl of about 10 years old was calmly walking around the store, looking around. Suddenly, an employee started asking her questions about where her parents were and if she was alone. The girl calmly explained that her mother was in the store next door and had said she could go into the pet store.
The employee then replied that children cannot be alone in the store and that she had to leave. Her tone gradually became irritated, and finally she raised her voice and said that “it is not her job to look after children”.
I had not even noticed the girl before this, as she was acting completely calm and quiet. The employee’s behavior seemed unnecessarily strict and unprofessional.
Not much commitment to be found here among the employees

Good selection of fish and expensive equipment.
they only had budgies. And no other birds. A bit boring 😏 …

What a dramatic change! This was one of the best aquarium shops in Eastern Norway, with great selection, customer service and knowledge.
Now I don't even think about visiting this shop. There is nothing "XL" about this shop.

Real downfall to get there now, it was exciting and informative for aquarium enthusiasts. But now it's just any store without any soul or wow factor. Drove several miles to visit this store. But now I don't bother going there anymore.
Had some stuff for reptiles, wish there was more tho
Nice store. Employees with important knowledge. Good service
I waited for 15 minutes and left. The service in the aquarium department was very slow.
A good store before with a large selection of most things, now it looks like a Lidl for dogs. Sad :(
Everything is here for our little loves

From Norway's best aquarium shop to a bracket down on a wall. I was disappointed. Here I bought my beautiful 430 liter move 10 years ago and received professional help. Today the staff had no idea about fish and they were not interested either. A lot of sick fish in the tanks and nematode attacks on live-feeders were evident. The only positive was a flock of rare African butterfly cichlids Thomasiene that looked nice and healthy. The nematodes are unfortunately destroying the entire aquarium hobby.

The inventory shown online does not match what they actually have available. Wasted trip to buy something they should have in stock. The staff just said the quantity is never correct because the "system" doesn't work.

There was a large selection of fish and many interesting species. They also had some wild caught dwarf cichlids.
Clean and nice tanks and I didn't see any sick fish. Definitely worth a visit
Good and patient dog groomer for a fearful old dog.
Large selection
Nice but a bit messy in most places. It could be that they had just received a delivery when I was there.

After PetXL bought Oslo Dyrebutikk, things have only gone downhill. The aquarium department is reduced with each "renovation". They send out a newsletter about a 25% discount on EVERYTHING except food; online it says 20%. You come to the store on Monday and the shelves are empty, the planter is completely empty and almost no fish in the aquariums. By Friday, the shelves and aquariums have been minimally restocked. The planter is still empty. Completely understaffed store; 1 hour wait. The store suddenly tells you that you will not get the advertised discount on aquarium fish.

I like this store specifically because it's big and open space. I personally just feel a lot more comfortable shopping here. I know they offer a lot of services and have great service but for 1 cat I don't use it much.
Friendly

Not even a shadow of the store it once was. The aquarium department has shrunk to a fraction of what it was, and gone are the pleasant employees who knew a lot about fish and who knew customer service. This is no longer a good store for aquarium enthusiasts.

Disappointing and sad sight that met me today after not having been here for a few months. The fish department has been reduced to one wall (equivalent to a much smaller store), reptiles and small insects have been completely removed (I couldn't buy either springtails or food animals) and the service was rather poor.
This store used to be almost like a lush zoo that both adults and children looked forward to visiting (and driving far to).
They have set aside an insane amount of space for animal food and equipment (which many probably prefer to buy online). I'll give it another try in a few months, but without high expectations. A plus today was that I got a big discount on a lot of equipment for terrariums (probably because they are phasing it out).
There are too many changes and replacements here in everything from products to staff for you to feel cared for as a pet owner or customer. I miss the Oslo pet store that used to be here.

very bad service. I had to pay fee for taking care of my order (whatever thats mean) and since ordering day -wednesday, my iten was sent next week tuesday...that is not taking care of order and there definitely shouldn't be an additional fee. The store ignored the situation and treated it as normal, so thank you. I definitely won't be going back there.
Never had a problem. Sour service.

This was my "go to" pet store in the Oslo area, they had everything I needed, but after the renovation they have removed the entire reptile department and replaced it with ONE shelf for some very limited equipment. For me the store was the alpha and omega, now it is simply useless, for me. Probably still great if you have a dog, cat, or aquarium fish.

The store has lost its way in the last year. Slowly but surely the aquarium department is being phased out. From the best fish store to a standard chain. Now there are only 1/3 of the aquariums that were there before. The aquariums are impersonal and sad. I was actually sad when I visited the store today.

Stopped by to buy shrimp tubes so the shrimp have a place to hide, after walking around for 20 minutes without seeing a vacant employee, someone came to the checkout. Asked if they had shrimp tubes, what was that, I got an answer, showed a picture from their own website. Then got an answer that no we don't have them, have used them for our own aquarium here in the store. Never again in that store.
Really good service
They have pretty bad customer service here every time I come by😅 …

I rarely find things in the same place. Categories are moved around here every time I stop by. It's not good to have to stand in line to ask for things you can't find. Otherwise, a big, nice store and nice people at the checkout.

Steer clear, they sell substandard products. Refuse to accept it for exchange. Even though there is a clear warranty on the package. The product lasted 3 months.. Strongly recommend shopping at more reliable pet stores
Small center
Very nice aquarium section

Do not buy fish here!
I bought 10 neon tetras from here, and one died on the way home, which I thought was due to stress. After about a week the rest died, from neon disease. The store could not do anything about this, since it had been more than 4 days since I bought the fish. PetXL Alna only has a 4 day guarantee on fish.
This is the first and last time I shop here, not recommended.

I usually buy fish at Dyrego Zoo Oslo City, and have never had any problems, neither with tetras nor any other species, I highly recommend going there instead! It is cheaper, better quality and knowledgeable, friendly staff who give good advice.
Top service at reasonable prices
Many dead fish in several of the aquariums. Seems like they have lost some good people, with knowledge of fish. Not the same quality anymore.
Very big shop, large diversity of products. Great service.
Good service and large selection.
Probably a really good store,,,🤔 but gave up visiting when it was impossible to figure out their parking system at the center,, …

From what I have seen of pet stores in my area, this has become one of the few pet stores that still has fish, birds, small rodents and reptiles that you can actually see live. It certainly makes it extra nice/cozy for children/adults to …
Great store, but often sold out of a lot of items.
